title_as_printed: Viscosities of CO2-saturated and non-CO2 NaCl + CaCl2 solutions at 5.00 mpa under varying temperature, (S7:19wt%NaCl + 1wt%CaCl2, S8: 19wt%NaCl + 1wt%CaCl2 + CO2)
pressure_note: Table title gives 5.00 and/or 8.00 MPa; sample kept at that pressure by a back-pressure regulator with a CO2-filled buffer vessel for saturated runs. Total or partial not stated.

composition.note: set per block by label rows from the table caption (S7: 19 wt% NaCl + 1 wt% CaCl2; S8: same + CO2); Table 4's 'mol kg-1' entries for S7/S8 (3.25, 0.09) are mol per kg of solution (190 g/58.44 = 3.251; 10 g/110.98 = 0.0901), not molality

notes: Side-by-side blocks stacked left to right. CO2-saturated blocks (S2,S4,S6,S8) have gas co2. P is constant per block, set in the label row.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: Composition taken from the caption (19 wt% NaCl + 1 wt% CaCl2) instead of Table 4's 'mol kg-1' (3.25, 0.09), which are per kg of solution; the true molalities are 4.064 and 0.113 mol/kg water (the same wt%-to-molality check reproduces Table 4 for S1 and S5).
